reviews.text: The shoulder buckle snapped the first time my daughter wore it to school.
The fabric looked cute but felt thin and rough after one wash.
The seams near the pocket started opening after a normal playground day.
The fit was too short in the torso even though the legs were too long.
The color faded quickly and looked old after two laundry cycles.
The metal clasp was hard for a child to open during bathroom breaks.
